description.value: Paz Fuels is a family-owned independent gas station that has served the Fraser Valley for over 50 years, operating around the clock and offering diesel, propane, dyed fuels, and EV charging alongside a full market café. The on-site Paz Market sets this station apart from typical convenience stops, serving fresh made-to-order meals from a chef, smoothies, pizzas, and café-quality coffee. An eco-friendly automated car wash using recycled rainwater and vehicle vacuum stations round out a surprisingly full-service stop for travellers on Fraser Highway.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at pazfuels.com fetched successfully and confirms this is a real, actively operating family-owned independent gas station at 27988 Fraser Hwy, Abbotsford BC V4X 1M2, with current fuel prices displayed. The site describes an on-site 'MARKET cafe and convenience store' serving fresh, made-to-order food including breakfast sandwiches and pizzas, confirming basic groceries and hot food. Propane refill is explicitly listed as a station service, qualifying as camping fuel; EV Charging appears as a navigation menu item but no specific e-bike outlet is described, and no mention of bike parking, washrooms, or water bottle refill was found anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone; both sourced from website only

Website contains COVID-19 era content (plexiglass, distancing notices) suggesting some sections have not been updated since ~2020, though current fuel prices are displayed indicating active maintenance
Market subpage describes location as 'Aldergrove' while contact page says 'Abbotsford'; Aldergrove is a community within Abbotsford so this is likely not a discrepancy but worth noting
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible gas station with convenience store and café; a practical resupply stop for touring cyclists on Fraser Highway.

Hot food.detail: Made-to-order menu from on-site chef including breakfast sandwiches, oven-hot pizzas, smoothies, and café-quality coffee and lattés

Camping fuel.detail: Propane refill explicitly listed as a station service on the front page

wow_evidence: family-owned independent gas station that has served the Fraser Valley for over 50 years
